### D0001

**Factual Intent:** The Mexican Treasury Secretariat (SHCP), through Karina Ramírez Arras in her official capacity as Titular de la Unidad de Política de Ingresos No Tributarios, formally established differentiated fiscal fuel-stimulus percentages under the IEPS framework for the period December 10–16, 2022, granting 26.96% stimulus to gasoline below 91 octanes, 0.00% to gasoline ≥91 octanes and non-fossil fuels, and 59.77% to diésel.

**Period fit:** December 10–16, 2022. All intents fall within Q4 2022, the final quarter of the López Obrador presidency's first half-year. The policy represents a routine administrative exercise under pre-existing legal authority rather than a novel programmatic initiative. **Limitation:** This document records the administrative mechanics of a fuel-tax subsidy mechanism; it does not by itself establish whether the policy served broad-based prosperity or corrected rather than reinforced regressive energy subsidies.
